newsitem.title: USA: VideoLan off after chosen as featured short.
newsitem.headline: VideoLan off after chosen as featured short.

text.p: Shares of VideoLan Technologies Inc slumped two points, or 24 percent, to 6-1/4 on Wednesday after it was chosen as a stock to short by an analyst in the Wall Street Journal.
The stock touched a new low of 6-1/8 and was one of the leading falling stocks on the Nasdaq on a percent basis.
The company was not available for comment.
Analyst William Edwards of Palo Alto Investors said VideoLan's stock could fall to its August 1995 intial public offering price of $4 by the end of February.
The Louisville, Ky., company develops video conferencing technology.
